posts.title: Ten Years Of Emacs
posts.description: This post is a reflection on over ten years of Emacs usage. Why did I even start using it? How has my usage changed over the years? What's the future looking like? I'll discuss this and a whole lot more. It's a spiritual successor to my post.

posts.title: Linux Gaming: Fallout 1
posts.description: Fallout 1 is "a post nuclear role playing game" released October 10th, 1997 on DOS, PC, and Mac platforms. Despite its age, it's definitely worth playing nowadays and has a couple of different ways to play on Linux including a native port. posts.description: Some time ago, using to more easily install and run the original Morrowind executable on Linux via wine. Recently, WEM has seen some feature additions that enable making most of the steps fully automated. Read on to see how installing games with WEM has changed!
